name: folio

scripts.author: node --experimental-strip-types tools/authoring/cli.ts
scripts.coverage:all: mkdir -p .coverage && npm run coverage:unit >/dev/null && npm run e2e >/dev/null && node tools/coverage-report.mjs --per-file

comment:coverage-combined: Combined coverage measured 94.95-95.05% across runs (2026-10-03). The floor is 94, not 95, deliberately: the browser half varies by a few lines run to run (animation loops and the sim engine), and a floor set at the peak would fail on rendering timing rather than on a regression. Raise it when the browser contribution is made deterministic.
comment:coverage-floor: coverage:gate hardcodes the floor rather than relying on `npm run X -- --min N`. The passthrough is npm-version dependent: it applied in CI and silently did NOT apply locally, which would have left the gate unable to fail after an npm upgrade. Hardcode, like test:gate.
comment:coverage: test:gate floors are a RATCHET — raise them in the PR that earns the improvement, never lower them to make a build green (CON-COV-002). Destination is 95. Baseline 38.91/74.52/39.41 set 2026-09-20 when import-all first forced the whole of src/ into the denominator (the previously reported 87.65% measured only five files). Phase 1 raised it to 86.05/71.67/75.42 — branches fell because newly-covered files brought their unexercised branches into the denominator, which is the honest direction. Remaining climb to 95 needs browser-side coverage (shader/engine/tilt) — Phase 2.
comment:author: The AI authoring pipeline (npm run author) needs @anthropic-ai/sdk. Install it on demand — `npm i -D @anthropic-ai/sdk` — it is not part of the app build.
